title: Settings file
description: Save your settings to a JSON file, or load one someone shared with you. API keys, accounts, integrations and agents are never included.

view.label: View settings JSON
view.summary: Read-only preview of the file that Export saves.

toast.applyFailed: Some settings couldn't be saved. Try the import again.

confirm.title: Replace your settings?
confirm.description: Settings from {{name}} will replace yours. Anything the file leaves out stays as it is.
confirm.ignored: Not recognized, so they'll be skipped:

error.title: {{name}} wasn't imported
error.notSettings: This isn't an Oleafly settings file.
error.newerVersion: A newer version of Oleafly made this file. Update Oleafly, then import it again.
error.invalid: Some values aren't allowed, so nothing was changed:

valueErrors.range: must be a number from {{min}} to {{max}}
valueErrors.wholeRange: must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}
valueErrors.wholeRangeStep: must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}, in steps of {{step}}
valueErrors.hexColorOrEmpty: must be a color like #2563eb, or "" to use the theme's color
valueErrors.text: must be text, at most {{max}} characters
valueErrors.webAddress: must be a web address that starts with http:// or https://
valueErrors.list: must be a list of at most {{max}} entries
valueErrors.object: must be a group of settings in braces
valueErrors.dictionaryLocale: must be a dictionary code like en_US
valueErrors.shortcut: must be a shortcut like Mod-Shift-k, or "default"
valueErrors.editorKey: must be a key like Mod-d, "" for none, or "default"
